name: Sector 112 Gurgaon
shortDescription: Sector 112, Gurugram is a well-connected residential locality near Dwarka Expressway, offering a mix of premium apartments, builder floors, and modern residential developments.
longDescription:
Sector 112, Gurugram is a developing residential destination strategically located near the Dwarka Expressway and Delhi-Gurugram border. The sector benefits from excellent connectivity to Delhi, IGI Airport, Dwarka, NH-48, and major employment and commercial hubs across Gurugram.

The locality features a growing range of modern apartments, luxury residences, builder floors, and residential projects, making it suitable for both end-users and investors. Its location near Dwarka Expressway provides convenient access to important areas such as Palam Vihar, Sector 22, Sector 23, New Palam Vihar, and other established parts of Gurugram.

With improving infrastructure, expanding residential development, nearby schools, healthcare facilities, shopping destinations, and everyday conveniences, Sector 112 is emerging as a promising residential area in Gurugram. The combination of Delhi proximity, Dwarka Expressway connectivity, modern housing options, and future development potential makes Sector 112 an important location for residential real estate.

NestNeev Real Estate can help buyers, sellers, landlords, and tenants explore suitable property options in Sector 112 and surrounding Gurugram locations.
